name: s3ClearBucket
syntax: s3ClearBucket(bucketName [, maxage, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Deletes every object in an S3 bucket, leaving the bucket in place. With `maxage`, only objects older than that are deleted.

params.name: maxage
params.description: Only delete objects older than this timespan.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first argument `bucket` and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Doesn't list `maxage` or `timeout`.

examples.title: Empty a bucket
examples.description: Removes all objects from the bucket.
